mapper.select: SELECT operation_id AS operationId,reward_id AS rewardId,payload_digest AS digest,state,relation_count AS relationCount,created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_referral_reevaluation_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT relation_id FROM mk_referral_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} AND relation_id=#{relation} ORDER BY relation_id LIMIT #{limit}
